caption: The drawing features a large rectangular box resembling a wooden chest or casket positioned slightly diagonally across an otherwise plain, light-colored background. The box is rendered in shades of deep reddish brown with darker accents, giving the appearance of wood grain. A simple metallic handle is drawn on the nearest short side of the box. On the right side of the image, sketched in light pencil, there is a smaller, less detailed outline of a similar box, viewed from the front, with a faint indication of a keyhole or lock. The artist's signature, "Edna Rey," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Lap Desk
